english.note: Use this colloquial phrase for repairing a damaged or ruined thing and getting it back into good condition.

examples.english: My computer broke, so I took it in to restore it.
examples.traditional: 部電腦壞咗，我攞去整返好。
examples.jyutping: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2 ngo5 lo2 heoi3 zing2 faan1 hou2
